author: kevaundray
content:
since I was planning to bring up 8413 on ACDC as a potential orthogonal solution to 8205, posting it here: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12306/changes 

This does not completely solve the front-running issue because you can add stake and the operator can choose to not register against your stake.

author: knoshua
content: What happens when multiple stake transactions (try to) commit to the same validator credentials?

author: kevaundray
content: These would be seen as two separate stake deposits on the CL. A validator is able to register against only one of them though, the second stake can manually be refunded back to the attached withdrawal credentials (or we could say that any stake that is not registered within X epochs will be withdrawn back to the attached withdrawal credentials)
